Aged charcoal umber oak with cool blue-grey fissures, warm muted ochre on left-facing ridges, small patches of silvery sage moss, sparse tiny turquoise lichen. Intricate sculptural bark ridges which spiral and taper, chipped wood, knots and subtle ambient shadow IN the wood, tactile and legible at tiny scale. No cast shadow beyond object. Thick trunk with two near-parallel outer sides that have an organic silhouette; trunk body fills at least 76% of width. Top rim is near-horizontal with a dark elliptical open center, sturdy pale warm weathered oval rim with only slight chips, walkable ledge. Continuous organic grain over full height, asymmetrical knot and thin moss. Roots grip outward at the bottom only, blunt roots sit firmly on one shared level ground line. No upper branches, leaves, twigs, grass bed or side tunnels. Entire object in frame.
